Subject: Late-stage: availability governor / provisional GPU earmark for HelixAI (DEAL-4291)

Claire — thanks again for the time on Friday. HelixAI is moving quickly toward an EOW signature if procurement confirms the T&Cs. Before we get to legal/finance, ops asked me to put a short, formal request into the capacity planning queue so we don't get preempted during the Q3 ramp.

Ask: can Ops tentatively earmark ~12 A100-equivalent GPU slots for HelixAI for an initial 3-month committed window, starting mid-August? We will convert to a Dedicated reservation once procurement issues the PO. This is strictly provisional and cancellable if deal terms don't land.

Constraints/notes:
- Expected peak concurrent workers: 6 (batch/throughput oriented).
- Preferred region: us-west (to meet latency SLAs).
- Fallback plan: if capacity scarce we can route to a quantized T4-equivalent pool with slight performance impact; prefer Redwood to propose the cheapest viable fallback.

Karthik / Mina — please advise whether the ask is feasible and what the minimal notice and approval path looks like. Claire, copying your procurement contact is fine if you want Ops to talk directly about timing.

— Sean

Subject: Re: Late-stage: availability governor / provisional GPU earmark for HelixAI (DEAL-4291)

Sean — good timing. Quick summary from capacity side: current us-west pool has a nominal headroom of ~20 A100-equivalent slots in August, but allocations already scheduled for late August/Sept reduce flexible headroom to ~8 without rebalancing.

Options:
1) Provisional earmark (non-binding): we can mark 12 slots as "soft-hold" through Aug 20 with a requirement for PO/commit confirmation by Aug 15 to convert to a hard reserve. Soft-hold prevents automatic preemption but is revocable by capacity ops under emergency (we'll surface a notice).
2) Tiered approach: hold 8 A100-eq and 4 T4-eq as a mixed pool; this reduces ops risk and gives HelixAI a migration path.
3) Canary fallback: if no hard reserve by Aug 15, we automatically divert to a lower-cost quantized model variant (same model family, lower perf).

We need Ops (Mina/Connor) to confirm node IDs and whether any scheduled maintenance would conflict with the Aug window. Marissa: can you keep procurement cadence synced so Legal/Finance don't delay beyond Aug 15?

I'll attach a quick inventory snapshot.

— Karthik
